digest.component_or_area: tracker initialization and environment identity management
propositions: Re-cloning the tracker without preserving git-ignored .env-id causes a fresh uuid to be minted with no warning, invalidating all prior op-cert attestations signed by the old environment identity.

The env-id ensure-registry unit and _gen_local_files mint a new uuid whenever .env-id is absent without checking whether the store already contains events stamped with a different environment identity.

Minting a new environment identity over a store with existing events from another environment must warn loudly on stderr, name the prior env id(s), document the attestation consequence, list the git-ignored files to carry over, and complete only with REBAR_ALLOW_ENV_REIDENTIFY=1 override.

The fsck command must detect and report ENV_ID_MISMATCH issues when the current environment's author(s) also wrote events under a different env id, scoped to avoid false positives in multi-clone topologies with different authors.
A fresh clone mounting a shared tickets branch with a different environment identity is a legitimate first-class workflow and must remain writable without forcing an override.
